title: Columbus Mobility Mini-Grant
sponsor: City of Columbus Department of Neighborhoods
description: Supports nonprofits expanding transportation services for residents in Franklin County. Funds can be applied toward the purchase or lease of accessible vehicles, driver training, and insurance.
eligibility_bullets: Applicant must be a 501(c)(3) headquartered in Franklin County, OH
Project serves low-income or mobility-challenged residents

title: Dublin Youth Enrichment Fund
description: Grants for after-school or weekend programming that expands STEAM access, including equipment purchases and transportation costs.
eligibility_bullets: Nonprofit or school serving students in Dublin City School District
Program operates at least 12 weeks per year
Grant dollars cannot cover salaries above 40% of the request

title: Licking County Creative Spaces Grant
description: Provides capital support for arts organizations renovating rehearsal or community event spaces. Award covers materials, architectural fees, and accessibility upgrades.
eligibility_bullets: Applicant must show 3 years of programming history
Project must be completed within 18 months of award

title: Healthy Fairfield Micro-Grant
description: Micro-grants for nonprofits expanding health screenings, mental health counseling, or nutrition education services.
eligibility_bullets: Organizations must serve Fairfield County residents
Priority for programs with bilingual service delivery

title: Westerville Community Scholars Equipment Fund
description: Provides laptops, lab kits, or assistive devices for students in partner nonprofits that serve first-generation college applicants.
eligibility_bullets: Applicant must track student outcomes for 12 months after award
Must partner with at least one Westerville high school counselor
Equipment becomes property of the nonprofit after distribution

title: Gahanna Green Infrastructure Grant
description: Supports community gardens, urban forestry, and water conservation projects. Award covers landscape materials, rainwater systems, and community engagement tools.
eligibility_bullets: Project must occur within Gahanna city limits
Applicant provides maintenance plan for minimum 3 years
